subject: prd/contract-gate
statement: When the gate returns any failing verdict, it shall emit exactly **one** structured, template-governed defect report bundling every failed check's defects — each carrying its check id, the specific offender, and what unblocks it — in two faces, a machine-readable projection and a human-readable rendering; and when the verdict is `clean`, it shall emit no report and materialize no artifact.
rationale: one named, parseable bounce the owner and downstream consumers can act on; nothing persists on a pass (`#D-5`, `#D-1`)
fit_criterion: every failing fixture emits one report validating against both faces and enumerating all failed checks with offenders + unblocks; every clean fixture produces zero report and zero materialized artifact (filesystem + tracker inspection)
